description:
Manage thread files under threads/{Projects,Processes,Topics}/.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list thread files, open only by default; QUERY is a fuzzy search that ranks by similarity
  show THREAD [--json] — show a single thread file; THREAD is a name or 'Kind/Name'
  new [--name N] [--kind K] [--category C] [--currency ISO] [--rate R] — create a thread file; prompts interactively for any field not supplied
  delete THREAD [-y] — permanently delete a thread file

Flags:
  list: --all include paused/closed threads; --json JSON output.
  show: --json JSON output.
  new: --name NAME; --kind one of project, process, topic; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary; --currency 3-letter ISO code, default currency for `hours`; --rate hourly rate, requires --currency.
  delete: -y skip the confirmation prompt.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "2500"]
  ["delete", "Topics/Old", "-y"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts on stdin for any of --name, --kind, --category that is omitted. Always pass all three; --currency and --rate are optional and never prompted as required.
  `delete` is destructive and prompts unless -y is given; without a TTY always pass -y or do not call it.
  Threads must exist before notes, buffer entries, hours or payments can reference them.
